facts.fact: The article reports a letter from the head of the health ministry's preventive medicine and public health sector that refers to an automated system for registering births and deaths at the health offices, onto which data are entered; the article states no date for the letter, so its published date is used.
facts.system: automated system for registering births and deaths at health offices

facts.fact: The head of the Ministry of Health and Population's preventive medicine and public health sector wrote to every health affairs directorate in the country about the data entered on the automated births and deaths registration system at the health offices, and health inspectors at those offices issue the burial permits and death certificates; the article states no date for the letter, so its published date is used.
facts.system: automated system for registering births and deaths at health offices

facts.fact: The health ministry's preventive medicine sector instructed all health affairs directorates to unify and improve the quality of data entered on the automated births and deaths registration system at health offices, requiring every hospital, public, private and university, to use only the unified death notification form (January 2021 version, with a QR code) and health inspectors to accept it, with legal action for any laxity; the letter cites earlier instructions of October 2024, and the article states no date for it, so its published date is used.
facts.system: automated system for registering births and deaths at health offices
